html:
Best Salon Interior Designer

Designing Salons That Speak Style

A salon sells an experience long before it sells a service. Layout decides how many chairs you can run before the floor feels crowded; mirror lighting decides whether clients like what they see. We design salons around both realities at once - the commercial arithmetic behind the chair and the feeling a client gets in the first ten seconds at the door.

Our Salon Design Philosophy

"We believe that every salon has a unique identity, and its interior should reflect its brand, style, and target audience. Our approach combines modern trends with practical design solutions to ensure a space that is visually appealing, welcoming, and operationally smooth."

Residential & Commercial Salon Design

Whether you are setting up a luxury spa, beauty studio, or a neighborhood salon, we design interiors that are tailored to your vision. From seating arrangements and lighting to color schemes and décor accents, every detail is carefully curated to enhance the client experience and maximize space efficiency.

Functional & Aesthetic Excellence

A great salon design balances style with functionality. Our designs ensure:

  • Optimized Workflow: Thoughtful layouts for staff efficiency.
  • Client Comfort: Comfortable seating, ambient lighting, and soothing décor.
  • Brand Identity: Design elements that reflect your salon’s unique theme.
  • Modern Trends: Sleek finishes and innovative interiors.

Transform Your Salon

A perfectly designed salon enhances client experience, builds your brand reputation, and increases business potential. Partner with us to create a stylish, efficient, and inviting salon space that your clients will love and remember.

What the Best Salon Interior Designer Plans First

A salon is a business that clients sit inside for an hour at a time, so every design decision shows up both on the balance sheet and in the client's mood. The best salon interior designer works through these decisions in a deliberate order, starting with how the business actually runs and only then moving on to colour and décor.

Chair count and spacing

The number of styling stations decides how much revenue the floor can generate, but cramming in too many makes the space feel rushed. We test station counts on plan so stylists have room to move around the chair and clients never feel boxed in. It is the first calculation the best salon interior designer makes.

The client journey

We map the route a client takes: reception, waiting area, consultation, wash, styling, payment and exit. A good plan keeps these routes short and avoids clients with wet hair crossing paths with new arrivals.

Mirror lighting

Lighting at the mirror is the single most important detail in a salon. Even, flattering light on the face helps stylists see true colour and helps clients like what they see. We layer this task lighting with softer ambient light elsewhere.

Wash stations and plumbing

Basins need water, drainage and hot water supply in the right place. Planning these early avoids costly changes to the floor later and keeps the wash area comfortable and private.

Storage and back-of-house

Products, towels, colour mixing and staff areas all need space. When back-of-house is well planned, the front of house stays calm and uncluttered.

Materials That Survive Daily Salon Use

Salons face water, chemicals, heat and constant foot traffic. The best salon interior designer chooses surfaces that look good on opening day and still look good after years of use: water-resistant flooring, easy-to-clean counters, durable upholstery and finishes that do not stain from colour products.

Building a Brand Through Design

Your interior is a large part of your brand. A premium spa, a busy unisex salon and a boutique bridal studio each need a different atmosphere. We translate your brand into palette, materials, signage and lighting, so the space looks unmistakably yours in photos and in person. A salon that photographs well also markets itself, which is one more reason to work with the best salon interior designer you can find. Explore our related salon interior designer page for more on boutique and themed salons.

From Concept to Opening Day

Our process covers the brief, layout planning, photorealistic 3D views, working drawings, material selection, procurement and on-site execution. Pricing is transparent and milestone-based, with no hidden costs, and fixed timelines help you plan your launch. Our work is backed by a 10-year warranty. To see a finished example, visit our Star Salon project.

Why Salon Owners Choose 9th Corner

With 22 years of experience and more than 800 completed spaces, our team understands both design and day-to-day salon operations. That is why salon owners across Delhi NCR trust us as the best salon interior designer for new outlets and renovations alike.

Frequently Asked Questions

When should I hire a salon interior designer?

Ideally before you sign the lease. The best salon interior designer can tell you whether a unit can hold the number of stations, wash points and storage your business plan needs.

Can you redesign a salon that is already running?

Yes. Renovations can be phased to limit downtime, and the plan is built around the days and hours your salon cannot afford to close.

Do you design spas as well as salons?

Yes. Spas, beauty studios, unisex salons and bridal studios all follow the same careful planning, adapted to their treatments and atmosphere. If you want the best salon interior designer for a spa or studio, the process starts the same way: with a clear brief.

Plan Your Salon With Us

We work from our head office in Pitampura, Delhi, and our branch in Gurgaon. Book a free consultation and talk to the best salon interior designer for your next outlet about layout, budget and opening date.

  • High-Quality Execution
  • End-to-End Service
